name: Clipboard / Data Transfer Foundation

proposal_baseline.base_approval: USER-DIRECTED: dedicated branch created from the current remote HEAD of the approved integration base after fetch/prune on 2026-10-02; no existing clip-01 branch, registry row, or clipboard workstream was found on any remote branch.

registry_entry.activation_gate: Host clipboard/data-transfer contracts, the versioned content envelope, the authorization seam, tests, and the in-memory reference may be prepared on this dedicated branch. Compositor/window-manager clipboard ownership, keyboard shortcuts, primary selection, drag-and-drop plumbing, production IPC, target/QEMU service, durable history, Capability enforcement wiring, Activity/Wayback/AI integration, and first-party adoption require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit Integration Owner checkpoint naming CLIP-01.
registry_entry.merge_boundary: Dedicated codex/0.2-clip-01 branch only; integrate through an explicit checkpoint after review, and never merge directly to main, codex/integration-next-phase, or another workstream branch.

proposed_host_test_command.note: 27 host acceptance tests pass with the repository-pinned nightly-2025-08-01 toolchain, together with rustfmt --check and warning-denied Clippy on all targets. These host checks do not establish compositor, IPC, target, or first-party clipboard acceptance.

integration_owner_actions: DONE: registry_entry applied on codex/0.2-clip-01 (4595e7d) and integrated into codex/integration-next-phase (02e05f3).

DONE: clipboard.write accepted as an independent, unscoped permission covering write and clear (docs/decisions/ADR-0012-clipboard-permission-identifiers.md, commit 2bb35c5); clipboard.read covers reads. Runtime registration in a live CapabilityRegistry stays gated.

When a canonical MediaType contract is chosen, reconcile CLIP-01 MediaType with the private valid_media_type validator in sdk/rust/src/app_contract/manifest.rs (owned by app-sdk-contract); CLIP-01 is stricter (canonical lowercase, no parameters or wildcards).
After Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS, publish an explicit checkpoint naming CLIP-01 before any compositor, IPC, target, Capability wiring, or first-party adoption work.
Do not merge this dedicated branch directly to main or another workstream branch.
scope_notes: Only development-foundation is a hard dependency. capability-permissions, system-service-ipc, ident-01, diagnostics, and app-sdk-contract are adapter targets, not implied dependencies or edit permission.

The standalone crate depends only on the existing nagi-model 0.1.0 crate for AppId, AppSessionId, ExecutionInstanceId, and ObjectId. It defines no competing app, session, profile, principal, object, capability, or storage-handle identity.

The master 0.2 specification assigns no dedicated clipboard milestone; its clipboard references are the clipboard.read permission (section 10.1) and the M27 permission-aware Albert clipboard path. CLIP-01 host acceptance is therefore the workstream document's sections 4-6.

user/nagi-albert/src/clipboard.rs exists only on the active 0.1 M18 branches (ClipboardRuntime, ClipboardContext, TrustedClipboardGesture). It is a future consumer and was inspected read-only; CLIP-01 changes nothing on 0.1 branches.
One clipboard instance is profile/session-agnostic; per-profile or per-session scoping is a composition concern for the runtime owner once IDENT-01 ProfileId is integrated.
No clipboard history, durable persistence, cloud or cross-device sync, telemetry, AI ingestion, or Activity/Wayback payload recording is included.
Registration is applied on the dedicated branch only. Its state is now part of ./nagi dev verify on this branch; PASS still covers host Foundation acceptance only.
